title: 10-bit Differential SAR ADC
summary: A 10-bit differential SAR ADC designed in Cadence Virtuoso and verified for 200 MHz sampling.
points: Designed the comparator controller, with feedback timing that completes 10 comparisons inside a 4.5 ns hold.
Integrated the full 10-bit differential converter and validated SAR conversion at 200 MHz sampling across the input range.
Ran full-cycle transient simulations across conditions, then characterised the converter with INL/DNL and FFT tests. Cadence and analytical results agree across operating conditions.

title: InGaAs/AlInAsSb SACM Avalanche Photodiode for 1550 nm LiDAR
summary: A device-level analysis of a separate-absorption-charge-multiplication APD for 1550 nm LiDAR.
highlight: 0.76 eV conduction-band offset · ~49.3% single-pass absorption · M<sub>max</sub> ~17
points: Worked out band offsets, Fermi levels and alignment with Anderson's model, and built MATLAB transfer-matrix (TMM) simulations for the electric-field, absorption and EQE profiles.
Evaluated noise and responsivity with McIntyre excess-noise analysis, finding k between 0.02 and 0.04 and a maximum multiplication of about 17.
Used Vegard's law to quantify lattice mismatch and thermal strain against InP, a mismatch of 0.26%.

title: Two-Stage OTA with Frequency Compensation
summary: A differential two-stage OTA, taken from schematic through full-custom layout and extraction.
highlight: 63 dB gain · 118 MHz UGF · 113 V/µs · 0.3 mW
points: Designed the amplifier in Cadence Virtuoso with RC and tracking compensation, reaching 63 dB gain, 118 MHz unity-gain frequency, 113 V/µs slew rate and 60–72° phase margin within a 0.3 mW power budget.
Drew a full-custom layout of 34.35 × 45 µm² with common-centroid matching and structured routing on the critical devices.
Cleared DRC and LVS, then ran Quantus parasitic extraction to validate the final layout.

title: Arbiter-Based 2×2 Switch
course: EE 789 · Algorithmic Design of Digital Systems
summary: Three 2×2 packet switch architectures built from arbiters, queues, muxes and demuxes.
points: Designed packet-level arbiter mux and demux state machines with counters, so a packet is served completely before the switch changes input.
Added priority arbitration with packet-level toggling, which keeps access fair when both inputs are active.
Built three switch architectures from queues, arbiter muxes and demuxes for distinct routing paths, and validated all of them with the AHIR testbench and GHDL simulation.

title: Noise Cancellation and Digital Filtering in Verilog
summary: Four noise-reduction filters in RTL, carried through synthesis, place-and-route and full-custom layout.
points: Implemented LMS, spectral subtraction, Wiener and median filters in Verilog, each with a testbench.
Synthesised with OpenLane, including floorplanning, placement and routing, and extracted timing and power metrics.
Drew full-custom layouts in Magic, ran DRC, LVS and antenna checks and fixed the violations, producing GDS-ready layouts, and weighed area, power and frequency trade-offs.

title: ECG Amplifier Circuit
summary: An electrocardiogram front-end built from scratch, with right-leg drive and notch filtering.
points: Built the complete amplifier chain with right-leg drive (RLD) and a notch filter to pick up the cardiac signal cleanly and suppress interference.
Debugged circuit performance together with teammates.
